PR surface: Source +41, Tests +272. Total +313 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main has the implicated raw timers and fire-and-forget cleanup paths, and the PR body includes negative-control terminal output plus a real ClickClack gateway run; I did not rerun tests because this review is read-only.
